description: This file defines a DialogFragment subclass that displays a message dialog with a single OK button. It includes methods for creating an instance with a message resource ID and handles dialog creation and button click callback to a parent fragment.

classes.name: MessageDialogFragment
classes.description: A DialogFragment that shows a message with an OK button, designed for reuse with different message resources.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Creates a new instance of MessageDialogFragment with a specified message resource ID,

methods.name: onCreateDialog
methods.description: Builds and returns the AlertDialog displaying the message and handling OK button click.
